problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 7 delivery trucks to transport 7 different shipments.

Each shipment consists of a sequence of loading dock stops represented as pairs (Dock, Loading time),
where each pair specifies the dock where the shipment must be processed and the time required for loading.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the docks must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the route: (D5, 6) → (D1, 9) → (D4, 8) → (D7, 8) → (D2, 2) → (D6, 7) → (D3, 6)
* S2 requires the route: (D2, 1) → (D5, 4) → (D1, 2) → (D7, 5) → (D3, 2) → (D4, 3) → (D6, 3)
* S3 requires the route: (D4, 5) → (D1, 5) → (D3, 7) → (D7, 7) → (D6, 8) → (D5, 1) → (D2, 3)
* S4 requires the route: (D6, 5) → (D5, 3) → (D3, 3) → (D2, 9) → (D1, 5) → (D7, 9) → (D4, 1)
* S5 requires the route: (D2, 4) → (D7, 9) → (D4, 5) → (D6, 1) → (D1, 8) → (D3, 4) → (D5, 1)
* S6 requires the route: (D4, 2) → (D2, 3) → (D7, 2) → (D5, 9) → (D1, 1) → (D6, 2) → (D3, 1)
* S7 requires the route: (D6, 6) → (D2, 7) → (D4, 5) → (D5, 2) → (D3, 3) → (D7, 10) → (D1, 4)

Each loading operation must proceed continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each dock can only accommodate one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all shipments at the docks
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
